Definitely going to be a fun, surprisingly good-vibes team with no expectations, but it hurts because it’s not even like we’re a cursed team when it comes to drafting and development. We get every pick taken right when the lottery odds change, and play-in-tier teams can be rewarded at much higher rates. I will always be a fan, but this is pretty much as close to a franchise killer as it gets. It felt like it was all lining up for a truly refreshing era too.
